# infisical_certificate_sync_palo_alto_networks_ssl_tls_profile (Resource)

Create and manage Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS Profile certificate syncs. For setup, see the [Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS Profile certificate sync guide](https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/applications/certificate-syncs/palo-alto-networks-ssl-tls-profile).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_certificate_sync_palo_alto_networks_ssl_tls_profile" "example" {
  name           = "palo-alto-networks-ssl-tls-profile-sync-demo"
  description    = "Demo of Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS profile certificate sync"
  application_id = "<cert-manager-application-id>"
  connection_id  = "<app-connection-id>"

  certificate_filters = {
    # This sync holds a single certificate. Change the order ID to swap the profile's certificate.
    certificate_order_ids = [infisical_cert_manager_certificate.example.order_id]
  }

  sync_options = {
    certificate_name_schema  = "INF-{{shortCertificateId}}"
    can_remove_certificates  = true
    include_root_ca          = false
    preserve_item_on_renewal = true
  }

  destination_config = {
    ssl_tls_service_profile_name = "infisical-ssl-profile"
    ssl_tls_service_profile_vsys = "vsys1" # Leave unset when the profile is in the shared scope
    # template                   = "<panorama-template>" # Required when the connection is a Panorama, not allowed for a firewall
    push_to_devices = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the Certificate Manager application to create the sync in.
- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the palo-alto-networks Connection to use for syncing.
- `destination_config` (Attributes) The destination configuration for the certificate sync. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_config))
- `name` (String) The name of the Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS Profile sync to create.
- `sync_options` (Attributes) Parameters to modify how certificates are synced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_options))

### Optional

- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Whether certificates should be automatically synced to the destination when they are added or renewed.
- `certificate_filters` (Attributes) Which certificate this sync holds. Set `certificate_order_ids` to one certificate order. Leave the block out to manage the certificate outside Terraform, for example in the Infisical UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate_filters))
- `description` (String) An optional description for the Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS Profile sync.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS Profile certificate sync

<a id="nestedatt--destination_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_config`

Required:

- `ssl_tls_service_profile_name` (String) The name of the SSL/TLS service profile to bind the synced certificate to.

Optional:

- `push_to_devices` (Boolean) Whether to push the template to the firewalls in every template stack that contains it after each sync. Applies only when the connection is a Panorama and `template` is set, and the template must then belong to a template stack. Infisical commits the changes on the connected firewall or Panorama either way. Defaults to `true`.
- `ssl_tls_service_profile_vsys` (String) The virtual system that holds the SSL/TLS service profile, for example `vsys1`. Leave unset when the profile is in the shared scope.
- `template` (String) The Panorama template to sync certificates to. Required when the connection is a Panorama, and not allowed when it is a firewall.


<a id="nestedatt--sync_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_options`

Required:

- `certificate_name_schema` (String) The naming scheme for synced certificates, which must compile to 1-31 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores. Available placeholders: {{shortCertificateId}}, {{commonName}} and {{applicationName}}.

Optional:

- `can_remove_certificates` (Boolean) Whether Infisical should remove the certificate from PAN-OS when it leaves this sync. If removing the sync's certificate order while this is `true` would leave the SSL/TLS service profile without a certificate, Infisical rejects the apply. To change the profile's certificate, set `certificate_order_ids` to another certificate order instead. Destroying the sync leaves the certificate in place. Defaults to `true`.
- `include_root_ca` (Boolean) Has no effect for Palo Alto Networks: the sync always imports the full chain, root CA included. Defaults to `false`.
- `preserve_item_on_renewal` (Boolean) Whether a renewed certificate replaces its existing PAN-OS certificate instead of creating a new one. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--certificate_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate_filters`

Optional:

- `certificate_order_ids` (Set of String) The certificate order to sync, from the `order_id` attribute of `infisical_cert_manager_certificate`. Set one order. The sync keeps holding the newest renewal of that order.
- `metadata` (Attributes Set) Not supported on this sync. Setting it fails the plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate_filters--metadata))
- `profile_ids` (Set of String) Not supported on this sync. Setting it fails the plan.

<a id="nestedatt--certificate_filters--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate_filters.metadata`

Required:

- `key` (String) The metadata key the certificate must carry.

Optional:

- `value` (String) The value the key must have. Leave unset to match any value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the Palo Alto Networks SSL/TLS profile certificate sync by its ID
terraform import infisical_certificate_sync_palo_alto_networks_ssl_tls_profile.example <certificate_sync_id>
```
